## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in a few sentences.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests or an explanation of why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at desktop and narrow widths.
- [ ] Documentation reflects new commands, settings or provider behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, real histories, databases, logs or machine-specific paths are included.

## Provider and data integrity

- [ ] Missing provider measurements remain unavailable rather than becoming zero.
- [ ] Fixtures contain synthetic data only.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible changes, or remove this section.
